modelGuard.note: A route of these groups is vetoed where the request is a model change: a model element it never mentions with a build verb, a change verb or a UI widget; a build or change verb whose object is a model element (the verb not being a term of the route); a condition (quando/when/ao salvar/a cada) with any model element or click anywhere; a click on a UI widget; a concept that only exists inside an app (modelOnly). A trigger with a build or change verb holds only when that verb acts on one of its own nouns (objects). Readers (reader:true) never answer a build, change or save they do not name. Tools whose arguments are model elements (debugger, references, readers of a capture) are exempt. changeVerbs: with a model element among the words no tool explains, the hint says two parts; a verb after a modal (posso) is asked about.

application-owners.when: Discover application owners from verified module header links in resumable batches.
preconditions: Authenticated headless Service Center session. Only applications with visible modules are covered; empty applications require the application inventory.
application-owners.next: For large inventories use captureModuleSelection=true: first capture the module selection, then follow continuation unchanged, retaining auth selection. Captures bind host/principal/profile and content hash; module details are read live later, without relisting the captured inventory. Without capture, each batch rereads the listing and rejects drift. Combine rows only with the same moduleSelectionSha256, contiguous moduleOffset and unique moduleId. Check listingTruncated and unresolvedModules across ALL batches, not only the last. The module inventory hash does not make owner details a transactional snapshot. Deduplicate applications by ID with consistent names; use application-relationships with each applicationId for native dependencies. Default moduleBatchSize 10; ownerParallelism 1..8. Creator filters remain pending.

application-relationships.when: Read the application-level Dependencies table through its declared native tab event; distinct from the module reference graph.
preconditions: Authenticated headless Service Center session. Select numeric applicationId, exact application/applications, or a bounded application listing. applicationSource=modules explicitly resolves application owners from module headers, bounded by moduleLimit; auto uses this fallback only after a complete application listing yields no selected candidates.
application-relationships.next: Read at most applicationBatchSize applications per call (default 3), then follow continuation unchanged and combine returned batches. applicationOffset requires expectedSelectionSha256; changed selection refuses instead of mixing inventories. Inspect selectionSource, selectionScope, unresolvedSelectionModules and selectionTruncated/referencesTruncated. Module-owner discovery itself remains bounded by moduleLimit and may time out on large selections. It covers applications with visible modules, not empty applications. Empty application-table results do not imply absent module references. ownerParallelism (1..8, default 1) bounds independent module owner GETs and preserves inventory order; dependency tab events remain sequential. Creator filters and full legacy concurrency equivalence remain open.

application-dependency-graph.when: Read O11 application dependencies from verified module owner headers and forward reference tables.
preconditions: Authenticated headless Service Center session; moduleLimit bounds modules and limit bounds source references.
application-dependency-graph.next: Inspect truncated and unresolvedDependencies. application or applications filters exact consumer apps; includeSystem defaults to false and excludes only System, not System Components.
